title: Spare connectors
passage:
Where do we keep the spare connectors?
A. They should arrive by Friday. B. In the blue bin beside the test bench. C. We need twelve for each unit.
passageZh:
我們把備用連接器放在哪裡？
A. 它們應該最晚在星期五送達。
B. 在測試工作檯旁的藍色收納箱裡。
C. 每台需要十二個。
